name: Turnip Hoe
description: [Sword] A hoe. It has done more honest work than most legendary blades.

name: Village Sword
description: [Sword] Kept above the fireplace for exactly this occasion.

name: Broadsword
description: [Sword] Heavier. Simpler. Works.

name: Blade of Some Destiny
description: [Sword] Prophesied, though the prophecy is vague about which one.

name: Censer
description: [Flail] Swung on a chain. Doubles as a weapon, which is not what it was for.

name: Wellwater Staff
description: [Staff] Its healing is 30% better and its jokes are not.

name: Rod of Whatever Works
description: [Staff] Whatever works.

name: Shop Hammer
description: [Flail] Named Beatrice. Hob will tell you why.

name: Two-Handed Sledge
description: [Axe] Requires both hands and a certain outlook.

name: Beatrice II
description: [Axe] Hob made this one himself, and it shows, in a good way.

name: A Good Twig
description: [Staff] Structurally, a stick. Magically, a slightly better stick.

name: Secondhand Wand
description: [Staff] Still has the College's property stamp on it.

name: Unlicensed Starfall
description: [Staff] The College would like a word about this.

name: Borrowed Knife
description: [Dagger] Nix means to give it back.

name: Quiet Dirk
description: [Dagger] Makes no noise at all, which is the expensive part.

name: Last Word
description: [Dagger] Ends discussions.

name: Ancestral Lance
description: [Spear] Three generations of Pemberton-Gores have carried this and none of them found the exit either.

name: Halberd
description: [Spear] Reach, and a great deal of it.

name: Oathkeeper
description: [Spear] Sir Aldric swore on it once and has been extremely careful with it since.

name: Dented Lute
description: [Whip] Swung by the neck. The strings survive this better than you would think.

name: Road Fiddle
description: [Whip] Loud enough to be heard over a battle, which is the point.

name: The Instrument of Legend
description: [Whip] Piper wrote the legend first and then had the instrument made to match.
